spec.claim_summary: Go long when the 8-day EMA crosses the 21-day EMA, exit if price crosses the 21-day EMA or after 6 days.

claimed.other: much more profit than loss; 6 positions were taken in 10 months (304 days)

assumptions: Direction chosen long as closest testable core; claim only states 'cross' with no long/short side.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: possible opposite bearish-cross / short side is omitted because direction allows only one side (long or short).
Asset assumed BTCUSDT from page context; claim text does not name asset.
Timeframe assumed 1d from chart timeframe; claim text says 'day' EMAs.
Entry encoded as ema(8) crosses_above ema(21) on same bar close.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: dynamic stop 'just the other side of the 21 day EMA and adjust daily' cannot be encoded as pct/ATR trailing stop, approximated as exit on close crossing below 21-day EMA.
max_hold_bars 6 equals 'maximum of 6 days' on daily bars.
No fixed stop/target given; exit relies on EMA-cross failure condition plus time exit.

evidence.quote: The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross.
If price crosses the 21 day EMA , your setup has failed.
then monitor for a maximum of 6 days.
You can see that the above rules produced much more profit than loss.

audit_majors: direction: Claim is direction-agnostic: 'The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross' with stop 'just the other side of the 21 day EMA' applying to either side. Spec encodes long-only (ema 8 crosses_above ema 21) and omits the bearish-cross / short side. Marking it NOT EXPRESSIBLE does not fix it - omitting half the setups changes trade count and verdict.
